messages:
Owen (PM): quick idea 1: reduce first-run choices to 3 compact presets + a subtle 'Show all' link. want quick takes before I brief analytics.
Renee (Design): love less noise. mock: 3 centered cards, each with a one-line config blurb in monospace. 'Show all' opens modal.
Marcus (DevEx): agree but add a tiny 'Why this?' helper on each card (tooltip) — one sentence tradeoff. also change CTA from 'Create project' to 'Create workspace'.
Eve (A11y): accessibility: cards need role=group and H3 heading. focus needs to land on whole card, not just button. contrast check too (border should meet 3:1).
Hana (Eng): implementation: trivial UI changes + `POST /onboard/prefill` needs `preset_id` and `variant`. we'll emit events: `preset_seen`, `preset_chosen`, `preset_more`.
Owen (PM): metrics: AB test variants cards_3 vs focused_rail; primary metric: onboarding completion within 48h.
Renee (Design): will produce responsive specs and tooltip copy (2 lines max) by EOD.
PreviewBot: preview deploy for `feat/lean-onboard` is up: https://preview.redwood-inference/onboard-2095 :white_check_mark:
Marcus (DevEx): tiny copy note: under CTA add 'Includes sample app, prompts, and a cost estimate.'
Eve (A11y): I'll run quick checklist on the mock once shared. ensure dialog uses `role=dialog` and first focusable element is the heading.
Owen (PM): thanks team 1: let's ship behind flag next week and monitor.
